race.comment: ROCK EMPIRE (4) caught the eye first up over the unsuitable trip, then sat on the speed from the sticky gate with a tough victory over 1600m at Randwick in BM88 class. Has more to offer and adept in all conditions. GOLDEN CROSS (9) has gone to a new level this campaign with the three wins from his last four outings. Gets in light with McColm's 2kg claim after rounding them up over 1600m at Eagle Farm. Will relish the good tempo from the wide draw. Each way. EXPRESS PAYMENT (3) consistent gelding with the right set of figures to take this out. Three weeks between runs when he dropped in trip for a fast finishing second over 1400m at Eagle Farm. Jake Bayliss gets the best out of the gelding and expected to go close despite drawing out. TENZING (2) has excellent second up credentials and saves his best for this trip. Drifted back early when he resumed with an even tenth over 1400m at Eagle Farm. Gets the right run and sure to be thereabouts. The chances don't there.
